text:
If the courier can't find your parcel, the investigation (up to **5 business days**) ends with it being treated as lost. You then choose one of two options, both free:

- **A replacement:** we send a new one at no charge.
- **A full refund:** it goes back to your original payment method only. Once issued, cards take **5-10 business days**, digital wallets **3-5 business days**, and Leafy store credit is instant.

If you paid with buy-now-pay-later, the refund goes to the instalment provider, which adjusts your remaining payments.

Since the investigation only starts once I have your order number, please send it (LF- followed by six digits). Please don't share any card details.

I can also add a one-time goodwill store credit of up to **$15** for the delay if you'd like it.
